item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "19d6d4c66a055c16434af0e59f125f93de57bcfd5c3cfd4d63c8b38bf8004174",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "The real matrix has an indexed real basis consisting of eigenvectors, with a real eigenvalue assigned to each basis vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "Assumes diagonalizability over the reals; neither distinct eigenvalues nor an orthonormal basis is required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For q and flux F, every spatial section q(·,t) and every temporal flux section F(q(x,·)) is integrable on every bounded interval, and for all real a,b,s,t, ∫_a^b q(x,t) dx − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dx = ∫_s^t [F(q(a,τ)) − F(q(b,τ))] dτ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires these integrability conditions and the exact rectangular conservation identity for F(v)=Av, at all real times and endpoints.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Forms a finite sum over basis indices of traveling scalar step profiles multiplied by their basis vectors. Each scalar profile uses the corresponding basis coordinates of the three supplied states and travels at its assigned eigenvalue.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the actual function q in every analytic and pointwise conclusion; q is not an independent existential witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Returns the left value at a negative argument, the right value at a positive argument, and the separately supplied origin value at zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines both the vector initial data and each scalar coordinate profile, including exact values on characteristic lines.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Multiplies a fixed vector by the scalar value of the translated profile.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each summand of q is profile(x−speed·t) times its eigenvector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a profile at x−speed·t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the direction and rate of propagation, with no restriction on time.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Gives a commutative semiring its algebra structure over itself, with identity scalar embedding and multiplication as scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar action from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar action used in coordinatewise vector scaling.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All four principal conclusions hold for the same witnesses, and all parts of the conservation predicate are required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring structure of a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real arithmetic for the algebra instance without adding a hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying dependent function of a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the basis to be evaluated at an index to obtain its basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts division from a division-and-inversion monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real division for x/t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector and integral equalities are exact equalities, not merely almost-everywhere identifications.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the hypothesis and conclusion involve existence of eigenvalues and a basis; the conclusion's witnesses occur after the three states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite type equipped with a finite enumeration of all its elements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the index set to be finite and supports all matrix and profile sums; the empty index set is allowed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts scalar multiplication to functions pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "For v:ι→ℝ, scalar multiplication satisfies (c v)(i)=c·v(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from its typeclass.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the spatial argument x/t in the similarity identity as real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses scaling of eigenvectors by eigenvalues and of basis vectors by profile values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector space structure from an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies standard real scalar structure; it imposes no orthogonality condition on the chosen basis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts a strict order relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses positive time and, through the real order, the sign tests defining the step profiles.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row set m and column set n is a function m→n→α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is an arbitrary real array A(i,j) with both indices in ι, subject to the eigenbasis hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication, with (Av)(i)=Σ_j A(i,j)v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines both the operator in the eigenvector equations and the flux F(v)=Av.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Module.Basis",
      "meaning": "An indexed algebraic basis of a module, giving unique finite linear expansions of its vectors.",
      "effect_on_target": "The existential basis spans ℝ^ι and is linearly independent; it is not merely a family of eigenvectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Module.Basis.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a basis at i by applying the inverse coordinate representation to the finitely supported vector with value 1 at i and 0 elsewhere.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector denoted eigenbasis p is exactly the p-th basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital, nonassociative commutative ring structure from a nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes unchanged real arithmetic to matrix multiplication; it does not weaken the actual real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the commutativity field while retaining the underlying ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance projection supporting the real matrix action, with no additional mathematical condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributive laws from the ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the operations needed for finite real dot products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital commutative ring from its normed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real arithmetic for the matrix action without introducing analytic restrictions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminormed ring structure while forgetting its commutativity field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the construction of the standard real seminormed additive structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive analytic structure used for real scalar and vector spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring operations and metric while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the standard real normed ring to the arithmetic structure used by matrix multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations and norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the standard real normed-space and module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic module from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real module underlying ℝ^ι and its basis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal using its designated value in a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed 0 and 1 are real constants in the initial-time and similarity statements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 1 as the type's multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "The similarity profile is evaluated at real time 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Equips a function space with the pointwise module structure inherited from its codomain.",
      "effect_on_target": "The state space ℝ^ι is the usual real vector space with coordinatewise operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips dependent functions with pointwise commutative addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition and finite summation in q operate coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed additive commutative groups with its product normed group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the norm and topology on the finite real state space used in vector integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed vector spaces with pointwise scalar multiplication compatible with its product norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes ℝ^ι the normed real vector space required by the conservation predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Supplies the real inner product space structure on a real-or-complex-like scalar field.",
      "effect_on_target": "At ℝ, supplies the ordinary real normed scalar structure; it does not require the eigenbasis to be orthonormal.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All matrix entries, eigenvalues, state coordinates, spatial coordinates, and times are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The standard commutative additive monoid structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero to vector-space constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The standard commutative semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real arithmetic for the self-algebra and scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication, inversion, and division, with division defined by multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines x/t in the positive-time similarity statement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines positivity of time and the negative, positive, and zero branches of the step data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.instOne",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the reference time at 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real numbers viewed as a real-or-complex-like complete normed field, with real part the identity and imaginary part zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides standard real analytic instances and does not introduce complex scalars or complex eigenvalues.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real additive identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes initial time, profile origin, and the threshold in t>0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The reals with their usual additive group, absolute-value norm, and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the coordinate analytic structure for integration in the finite vector state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The ordinary real commutative ring with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real arithmetic and normed structures throughout the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual multiplicative norm and metric, including totalized inversion with inverse zero equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar field for normed spaces; the similarity conclusion uses division only when t>0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The standard semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar arithmetic required to define the basis and pointwise module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations, seminorm, and pseudometric of a seminormed commutative ring while forgetting its unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance conversion preserving the real analytic structure used in the vector-space construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the designated zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The literal 0 in the target denotes real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary division operation as a heterogeneous division operation with equal input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed division is ordinary real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a scalar action as the corresponding heterogeneous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed scalar-vector products use the supplied pointwise real action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, negation, and subtraction structure from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports vector subtraction in the integral conservation identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the additive and multiplicative operations of a commutative ring while forgetting its unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides unchanged real arithmetic to dependent constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "DFinsupp.instEquivLikeLinearEquiv",
      "meaning": "Views a linear equivalence as an equivalence with forward and inverse functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the coordinate linear equivalence to be applied to each supplied state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "meaning": "Extracts the forward function of an equivalence-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Evaluates eigenbasis.equivFun on a state to obtain its coordinate function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Finite.of_fintype",
      "meaning": "A type with a finite enumeration is finite.",
      "effect_on_target": "Discharges finiteness needed to identify basis coordinates with all functions ι→ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Finset.sum",
      "meaning": "Adds the values of a function over a finite set, with the empty sum equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The proposed q is a finite sum of its eigenvector contributions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Finset.univ",
      "meaning": "The finite set containing every element of a finitely enumerated type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every basis index contributes to q exactly once.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the order of subtraction in the change of spatial integrals, boundary flux difference, and translated profile argument.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "A function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the given measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires integrability between either ordering of each pair of endpoints; no endpoint ordering is assumed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "LinearEquiv",
      "meaning": "An invertible semilinear map for a specified scalar homomorphism; for the identity homomorphism it is a linear isomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "The basis-coordinate map is a real linear isomorphism, so its coordinates are uniquely determined.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the designated measure of a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrability and integral statements use the same designated real volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Module.Basis.equivFun",
      "meaning": "Maps a vector to its basis representation and then identifies finitely supported coordinates with ordinary coordinate functions on a finite index type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar step values are basis coordinates of the input states, not necessarily their original function coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "NonAssocSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital arithmetic structure of a nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited arithmetic and coordinate constructions without adding assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts commutative addition and zero from a semiring-like structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive structure needed for scalar sums and linear coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the analytic and additive setting of LocalDef002; the target instantiates it with the finite real vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed additive group structure while forgetting the commutativity field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited group and integration-related structures on the state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as a seminormed one with the same operations and norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the seminormed structure required for real normed-space and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides subtraction of state vectors and their integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with its associated extended nonnegative norm structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the norm structure used in the interval-integrability predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector-space structure over a normed field whose scalar action satisfies the norm compatibility bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables vector-valued integration in LocalDef002; it is instantiated by ℝ^ι over ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the induced topology used for integrability of state-valued functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.commRing",
      "meaning": "The usual real addition, multiplication, negation, subtraction, zero, and one, with commutative ring laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the arithmetic used by all scalar profiles and vector coefficients.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Real.decidableLT",
      "meaning": "Provides a decision of each real strict inequality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the step profile to branch on the sign of its real argument; adds no inequality assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The designated measure-space instance on the reals, supplied here through instance inference.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measure μ used by every integral; its construction and normalization are not expanded in this packet.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "RingHom.id",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism, sending each scalar to itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "The basis-coordinate equivalence is ordinary real-linear and uses no change of scalars.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "RingHomInvPair.ids",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism is inverse to itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar inverse compatibility for the coordinate linear equivalence without adding a hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the metric-derived topology needed for integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Semiring.toModule",
      "meaning": "Makes a semiring a module over itself using multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the ordinary real-linear coordinate space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's operations while forgetting its associativity field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports identity scalar homomorphisms and inherited arithmetic without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts subtraction from an additive structure with negation and subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction in the state space for the integral balance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology of a uniform space.",
